items.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995
items.q: the only things that drag us out are when people like Steve and Edye come to town and we go to one of the hotels where they are and see them

ctx.x: Tell us about life in Las Vegas, where you guys hang out most of the time.

Well life in Las Vegas is surprisingly dull. We’re very quiet when we’re at home. We rarely go out, we’re very apt to sleep in front of television in the evening, like many other people, and when Joe comes home his pleasure is to be home and eat at home and go and play golf if he feels like it or just sit and relax and listen to his music. And so we don’t go out a lot. We hardly ever eat out, and the only things that drag us out are when people like Steve and Edye come to town and we go to one of the hotels where…
Yes. How many animals do we have right now?
